summary: Domed stadium, so no aerial into the bowl is possible. Day slot: 2022 Conference USA Championship (UTSA home game) from the lower-bowl end zone under the roof lights. No separate night photo (indoors).

files.author: Blake675
files.credit_line: Photo: Blake675 / CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons
files.note: Indoor game view from the lower bowl behind the end zone, roof truss and video boards above; field across the middle, roughly rows 670-950, spectators' backs in the bottom quarter. Classed as day; lighting is indoor.
